reviews.t: Buying from Amazon from now on
reviews.x: Hv used this for years. Best makeup remover. Some people report it dries their skin, I haven't had this problem. Even though it is an oil, it doesn't leave my skin oily. DHC always recommends following this with a cleanser. This is a great deal because you get this booklet of samples.

This Deep Cleansing Oil is the best...have been purchasing it from DHC and using it for quite a few years...it's not any cheaper ordering it from Amazon but I needed it in a hurry. If I had been able to wait a month or so I would have been able to get it on sale from DHC...:-(

I should have listened to product reviews. I have been using DHC cleansing oil for about a year. Loved the results I was getting. I ordered this from Amazon and it looked darker and greenish. It caused my face to get bumps and at 67 years old that was surprising. I don't think this is the real stuff. I think Amazon should check into this and find out "what's up?"

reviews.t: Only cleanser that removes all my makeup
reviews.x: Ive been buying this cleansing oil for years. Its the only cleanser that gets off revlon colorstay liquid makeup. It doesnt make my skin feel dry or oily but I follow a 2 step cleansing routine and follow up the oil with Cetaphil gentle cleanser. This product came with a many samples  of products Ive been eyeing for a while, excited to try them.

I absolutely love this cleansing oil!! It removes my black liquid liner and mascara completely and I don't leave black marks all over my hand towel! It leaves my face feeling moisturized but not at all oily as it washes away clean. Love this stuff and will reorder!!

reviews.t: Not Thrilled.  Just So So.  Expected More From It.
reviews.x: I've used better cleansing oils before.  This one has a difficult time with eye make-up, particularly mascara.  I have to double cleanse to get everything off.  Won't purchase again, as there are better cleansing oils out there in the marketplace.

I've been using this product faithfully for 10 years. It is the best at taking off makeup. I am happy it's now available on Amazon. The added "book of beauty" was a nice plus - now I have travel size samples of all my DHC favorites.

reviews.t: Best cleanser I have ever used
reviews.x: I have used this for abut 3-4 years and I love it. And now it is on Amazon!! As I age I need more moisture and this does the job. My face is clean but not dried out. Highly recommend this! You can get travel sizes too.
Great cleansing oil. I've tried at least a dozen cleansing oils, and this one definitely gives you the most bang for your buck. I also really loved that it came with a pamphlet of other DHC samples!
I have used this product for several years and don't want to be without it.  I'd rather take makeup off with this cleansing oil than anything else.
I enjoy the way this cleanser deep cleans my skin, washes off easier than I had anticipated, and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth.

reviews.t: The best facial cleansing product out there!
reviews.x: I won't use anything else.  I have tried a lot of facial cleansing products.  I have mature skin which dries out easily and removing makeup can be a problem.  Either the product removes all of the makeup but dries out my face or it's gentle and moisturizing but leaves most of the makeup.  I have used expensive products and drug store products, DHC Deep Cleansing Oil is the ONLY product that removes the makeup and leaves my face soft and moisturized.

Seriously folks, if you wear makeup, you need to have this product. It melts makeup, including water resistant mascara, put one pump into dry hand, rub hands together then massage your face with it, rinse with water. It does not make you feel oily at all, but some feel like they need suds to feels clean. Well, the same company makes an olive oil soap that you can use after you rinse, or you could use your own face wash. I love this product.

After using this for a few weeks, I can say it's perfect for my skin.  I have fairly normal skin, but with an oily, flaky nose (nice combo, right?).  After using this morning and night for the past few weeks, my nose is less oily, and the flakes are pretty much gone.  It removes eye makeup better than anything else I've tried.  I'm now a huge fan of this and don't want to ever be without it!

reviews.t: I know it seems like an oil based cleanser would cause breakouts
reviews.x: I used this Deep Cleansing Oil years ago (like 18 or so years) and recently rediscovered it.  I know it seems like an oil based cleanser would cause breakouts, but that isn't the case at all.  I use it at night to remove my makeup and my makeup melts right off with it.  I don't need to follow with another cleanser after this.  Been using it for a few weeks and just love it!

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise it as an effective makeup remover that thoroughly removes foundation, mascara, and liner.
Many reviewers say it cleans without leaving skin dry or oily, and some note it keeps skin soft and moisturized.
The included free samples/booklet of samples is frequently mentioned as a great bonus with the purchase.
Several reviewers are long-time repeat buyers who have used the product for years.
A few reviewers report negative experiences, including breakouts or bumps and difficulty removing eye makeup.
